risk_description: Administrative account at a critical third-party service without multi-factor authentication
treatment: Enable MFA (hardware key or TOTP).

risk_description: Privileged productivity-suite account without MFA or separation from daily-use identity
treatment: Enable MFA; separate admin identity from daily-use account.

risk_description: Credentials or API keys at risk of being committed to source control
treatment: Enable secret scanning and push protection; rotate anything found; move all secrets to environment variables.

risk_description: Backups taken but never restore-tested
treatment: Perform and document one restore test per application; schedule quarterly.

risk_description: Single administrator across all systems with no documented recovery path
treatment: Document a break-glass procedure; store recovery codes in a sealed offline location; name a trusted contact.

risk_description: No data processing agreement with subprocessors handling personal data
treatment: Accept each provider's DPA; keep copies; maintain a subprocessor list.

risk_description: Applications collecting personal data without a published privacy notice or deletion route
treatment: Publish a privacy notice per app; implement account deletion; document the lawful basis.

risk_description: Application dependencies not monitored for known vulnerabilities
treatment: Enable Dependabot alerts on every repository; set a remediation SLA by severity.

risk_description: Unmaintained deployments potentially still reachable from the internet
treatment: Complete the application inventory; decommission or lock down anything unmaintained.

risk_description: Metered AI service keys without spend caps or usage alerting
treatment: Set hard spend limits and usage alerts on every AI provider account.

risk_description: No documented position on provider retention or training use of submitted data
treatment: Confirm each provider's data-use terms; disable training on customer data where offered; state it in the privacy notice.

risk_description: No application or administrative access logging
treatment: Enable platform logs; define a retention period; review monthly.

risk_description: Workstation holding source code, secrets and business records
treatment: Verify FileVault is on; enable Find My; enable automatic OS updates; screen lock under 5 minutes.

risk_description: Deployments promoted to production without review or documented rollback
treatment: Use preview deployments; require a self-review checklist before promoting; document rollback.

risk_description: Payment integration scope not formally assessed against PCI DSS SAQ-A
treatment: Confirm the integration keeps card data entirely on Stripe; complete SAQ-A; keep it on file.

risk_description: No documented incident response plan
treatment: Write a one-page IR plan: detect, contain, assess, notify, learn.

risk_description: Contractual security flow-down requirements not assessed
treatment: Review executed contracts for security flow-downs; if CUI is handled, run an 800-171 self-assessment.

risk_description: No access offboarding process for contractors
treatment: Maintain an access list; remove on engagement end; review quarterly.

risk_description: Critical service accounts tied to a single personal identity
treatment: Move critical accounts to a role address (admin@); ensure recovery methods are current.

risk_description: No documented security policy set
treatment: Adopt a minimal policy set: acceptable use, access control, incident response, vendor management, data protection.

risk_description: Assessment performed first-party; no independent review
treatment: Declare the conflict in every report; seek external review before relying on it commercially.

risk_description: Source code held in a single location with no independent copy
treatment: Keep an offline clone of every active repository; refresh monthly.
